mapper.select: SELECT PER_NO, NAME, SAMUSO, SAMUSO_NAME FROM TB_INSA WHERE PER_NO = #{perNo}
SELECT RTRIM(DEPT_CODE) AS DEPT_CODE, RTRIM(OFC_CODE) AS OFC_CODE, AUTH, RTRIM(APV_STS) AS APV_STS, RTRIM(DUE_DATE) AS DUE_DATE FROM TB_SCR_AUTH WHERE PER_NO = #{perNo}

SELECT RTRIM(A.DEPT_CODE) AS DEPT_CODE, RTRIM(A.OFC_CODE) AS OFC_CODE, A.AUTH, RTRIM(A.APV_STS) AS APV_STS, RTRIM(A.DUE_DATE) AS DUE_DATE FROM TB_INSA I JOIN TB_OFC_RAW R ON R.SAMUSO = I.SAMUSO JOIN TB_SCR_AUTH A ON A.DEPT_CODE = CAST(R.SAMUSO AS CHAR(6)) AND A.OFC_CODE = CAST(R.ONLINE_CODE AS CHAR(6)) WHERE I.PER_NO = #{perNo} AND A.PER_NO = '1'
SELECT KANM FROM TB_OFC_REG_MGT WHERE OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6))
